quote: A high no-op bias, down being heavily penalized, and a small set of "go up" units fits an agent that mostly waits and advances toward the top when the path is clear.
judge_notes: Argues from patterns it claims to see (W3 units, b3, W1 'per-cell detectors') and rules out Snake and paddle games on that basis. 'Weak evidence: Hand-reading the weights cannot rule out other dodge-and-collect games' is a hedge about its method, not a statement that the weights lack structure. Flag false: it says some large weights sit on dead inputs but treats the rest as meaningful detectors.
